svg.text: Three tiers: React client · Express 5 API (Node.js 24) · MongoDB. Deployed as one Render web service that serves both the API and the built app.
Render web service — one Node.js process (API + static React build)

g.text: React single-page application (static build, served by the same service)
React 19 · Vite 8 · MUI 9 · Redux Toolkit · React Router 7 · Axios (one client per account type)
set in CI. Transactions need a replica set.
client: lint, tests, build · server: tests on mongo:7
one web service · auto-deploy on push · health check /api/health

business rules: leave, attendance, people, training…
every query limited to the caller’s organisation
